column1: # The compare pairs of gate G12 (docs/design/compare.md, section 9.2). One pair per line, tab-separated:
# class (lab, oxpt, dox, dcb), set (curated: every pull request; full: the nightly or explicit run, which holds the curated
# ones too), the SHA-256 of the original and of the revised document (each listed in corpus/manifest/), a label, and the
# reason the pair is a noise outlier of N9 (section 9.4) or `-`. The pairs of a class and how they were found are in
# corpus/SOURCES.md. `cargo xtask corpus fetch` fetches the documents of the curated pairs, and `--pairs` all of them.
